summary: Verified MT-037 Safe Render / Data Integrity Gate fix. All 3 target Product Detail pages (PRD-00001, PRD-00002, PRD-00011) that previously threw 'undefined is not an object (b.who_for)' now render successfully with safe placeholders (Who this is for: 'General Audience', Coming Soon fallbacks). Zero TypeErrors, zero React error overlays. Regression product WITH creative_brief (PRD-00003) still renders real values including 'This poster is for anyone who wants a simple, thoughtful reminder of what love can look like in everyday life.' and the Preview & Marketing Kit panel works. /store, /founder-inbox, /asset-vault, /knowledge all load content and never show white screen or safe-render-fallback. Navigation from product detail back to /products recovers cleanly. Expected [QRU Data Integrity Gate] warnings appear in console (informational, not errors). Fixed one cosmetic leftover: a stray ')}' text node was rendering visibly on every product detail page (line 306 in ProductDetail.js was a dangling conditional close). Removed and re-verified.
critical_code_review_comments: ProductDetail.js: /app/frontend/src/pages/ProductDetail.js line 23 has React hooks exhaustive-deps eslint warning (load and loadKit missing from useEffect deps). Not a bug, but flagged by CI.

ProductDetail.js originally had a stray ')}' at old line 306 — leftover from a previously removed '{p.creative_brief && (' wrapper. It rendered as visible text on every product detail page. Fixed by testing agent by deleting the orphan line. Root cause: incomplete refactor when the creative_brief conditional was replaced with an unconditional block (since normalizeProduct now guarantees a safe brief).
normalizeProduct returns _safe/_missing metadata on the product but nothing in the UI surfaces these fields to the Founder (would be a nice-to-have maintenance flag).
context_for_next_testing_agent: MT-037 Safe Render™ / QRU Data Integrity Gate™ verified end-to-end. Products without creative_brief render with placeholders; products with creative_brief still render real values. ErrorBoundary safety net wraps <Outlet/> in Layout.js and never triggered on the tested pages. Testing agent fixed one cosmetic leftover (stray ')}' on line 306 of ProductDetail.js). No further action needed.
rca of the issue: Original crash: ProductDetail.js read p.creative_brief.who_for on line ~284 without a null guard; 24 seeded products had creative_brief undefined → TypeError. Fix (verified working): normalizeProduct() in /app/frontend/src/lib/safeRender.js always attaches a safe creative_brief via safeBrief(), providing who_for='General Audience' and other fields default to 'Coming Soon' / 'Not Yet Assigned'. Additionally, ErrorBoundary in Layout.js gives a page-level Safe Render fallback for any future unforeseen render errors and resets on route change via routeKey={location.pathname}. Secondary cosmetic bug (fixed by testing agent): a leftover ')}' from a prior '{p.creative_brief && (' JSX conditional was left orphaned when the conditional wrapper was removed — visible as text on every product page.
